description: The plot illustrates the relationship between training steps and BPC (bits per character) for two different validating methods. The x-axis is labeled “Training Steps (x10³)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50, with tick labels at intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled “BPC” and has a linear scale ranging from 1.2 to 2.2, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. A magenta line, marked “SimSMoE Validating”, begins at approximately 2.1 at x=0 and decreases to approximately 1.25 at x=10, then continues to decrease to approximately 1.15 at x=20, and remains relatively steady at approximately 1.13 to 1.15 until x=50. A black line, marked “SMoE Validating”, begins at approximately 1.65 at x=0 and decreases to approximately 1.25 at x=10, then continues to decrease to approximately 1.15 at x=20, and remains relatively steady at approximately 1.12 to 1.15 until x=50.
